1.web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
1.asv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, Than a house full of feasting with strife.

2.web: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
2.asv: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, And shall have part in the inheritance among the brethren.

3.web: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
3.asv: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; But Jehovah trieth the hearts.

4.web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
4.asv: An evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; Anda liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.

5.web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
5.asv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker; Andhe that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

6.web: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
6.asv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; And the glory of children are their fathers.

7.web: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
7.asv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool; Much less do lying lips a prince.

8.web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
8.asv: A bribe isasa precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; Whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

9.web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
9.asv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter separateth chief friends.

10.web: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
10.asv: A rebuke entereth deeper into one that hath understanding Than a hundred stripes into a fool.

11.web: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
11.asv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

12.web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
12.asv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, Rather than a fool in his folly.

13.web: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
13.asv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, Evil shall not depart from his house.

14.web: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
14.asv: The beginning of strife isas when one letteth out water: Therefore leave off contention, before there is quarrelling.

15.web: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
15.asv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to Jehovah.

16.web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
16.asv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, Seeing he hath no understanding?

17.web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
17.asv: A friend loveth at all times; And a brother is born for adversity.

18.web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
18.asv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, And becometh surety in the presence of his neighbor.

19.web: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
19.asv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: He that raiseth high his gate seeketh destruction.

20.web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
20.asv: He that hath a wayward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

21.web: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
21.asv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow; And the father of a fool hath no joy.

22.web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
22.asv: A cheerful heart is a good medicine; But a broken spirit drieth up the bones.

23.web: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
23.asv: A wicked man receiveth a bribe out of the bosom, To pervert the ways of justice.

24.web: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
24.asv: Wisdom is before the face of him that hath understanding; But the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

25.web: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
25.asv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her that bare him.

26.web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
26.asv: Also to punish the righteous is not good, Norto smite the noble fortheiruprightness.

27.web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
27.asv: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; And he that is of a cool spirit is a man of understanding.

28.web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
28.asv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; When he shutteth his lips, he is esteemed as prudent.
